footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to OUTFRONT: after $7.9M of preferred dividends.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue was flat at $1.8B in 2025. Operating income fell 31.0% to $294M, a 16.0% margin.
Net income fell 44.2% to $139M, or $0.82 per share. Operating cash flow was $308M and free cash flow $219M, versus $221M; OUTFRONT returned $210M through dividends.
sources: OUTFRONT Media Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
